candidates.change_summary: Replace the revert statement with a return false to change the return value from true to false on failure.
Change the constant literal 10 to 9 in the exponentiation for _value, altering the calculated transfer amount.
Replace the condition _tos.length > 0 with _tos.length == 0, allowing zero-length arrays and changing reversion behavior.
Remove the first require statement, allowing zero-length _tos arrays without revert.
Delete the entire for-loop body so that no external calls are made, but return true is still reached.
Change return true to return false to always signal failure even when all transfers succeed.
Replace the `_value` calculation so it uses division instead of multiplication, drastically changing the transferred amount.
Replace `require(_tos.length > 0)` with `require(false)`, causing every call to revert instead of transferring.
Delete the `revert()` inside the loop, so failed internal calls do not revert the whole transaction, changing return value and external effect.
